Message:
feat(desktop): implement Local-First Desktop Agent Harness (DSK-0 through DSK-10 core)

- apps/desktop: Tauri v2 + Node 22.x ESM sidecar harness with hardened CSP
  - LocalSidecarController: SQLite WAL, OS lockfile, DESKTOP_ADDONS, company-partitioned queries
  - DesktopCapabilityBridge: frozen IPC membrane, origin validation, R0-R4 risk gating
  - GitWorktreeSandbox: isolated per-run worktrees, path containment, symlink/junction protection
  - LocalMcpHostRegistry: stdio/loopback MCP with execution-time risk gate
  - DesktopUpstreamSyncClient: exponential backoff, conflict quarantine
  - 12/12 passing unit tests

- packages/orm: fixed belongsTo overload signatures (removed invalid const O type params)
  - Restores ModelValues type inference for belongsTo relations
  - 23/23 ORM tests pass, 22/22 orm-base tests pass

- apps/api: desktop sync endpoints (PCW protocol)
  - POST /api/ai/desktop/lease (fencingToken lease claiming)
  - GET /api/ai/desktop/pull (company-scoped policy/grant/work pull)
  - POST /api/ai/desktop/artifacts/upload (SHA-256 verification + storage)
  - POST /api/ai/desktop/pcw-sync (envelope reconciliation, server-only accepted invariant)

- apps/board: progressive enhancement for window.__MW_DESKTOP__
  - useDesktopBridge() hook with SSR safety
  - DesktopHarnessDrawer using @moonwitness/ui primitives
  - Mission Control Chrome integration

- Non-overlap invariant gate: scripts/check-desktop-non-overlap.mjs added to CI

- CI: pnpm desktop:ui:check, build, typecheck, test in quality lane

- docs: ADR 0008, desktop architecture, AI Corporation desktop harness blueprint

All gates pass: desktop tests, ORM tests, board typecheck/lint/budget, non-overlap check, prettier.
